_note: 2_05 'Tad's House' — Russell and Jimmy egg Tad's place: six shuttered windows while stealth patrols walk the yard, then fight the way back out (recon: docs/re-notes/ch2/2_05-tads-house.md). **No 2_05_new.DAT was ever extracted** — the geography is Tad's property, which is literally shared with 2_03 (same gate props per the recon), so this mission borrows imported/triggers/2_03.json; the few invented points (tads_gate = the 2_03_FrontGateArea volume's center, back_gate_out = the 2_03_Back_Unlock volume's center, and the start at the school front) are marked. v1 simplifications (see the recon's gap table): the baked 2-05 cutscene is a title card + speech beat; Russell's bike ride (PedFleeOnPathOnBike, the 80 m warp-leash, the take-his-bike fail) is an on-foot npc_lead — no vehicle bundle; the six room-eggings are six stationary target dummies at the 2_03 file's own yard/cover points (the shutter props and projectile-impact triggers aren't drivable world props — same posture as 1_04/2_S02); Tad's shutter-close work-queue (npc_task_queue) is a single invulnerable color NPC + one bark; the stealth patrols are one spotter (spotted event is logged; the original's post-bark escalation is engine-side, INFERRED there); the egg economy (24 eggs, 2 stash refills, out-of-eggs fail) is skipped — eggs are a narrative item here (no ammo economy yet); the stay-in-yard watchdog is a real zone_timer on the yard box; the reinforcement patrols and their walk-then-attack entrances compress into the final three-prep wave; the dead-code bike attackers are dead in the original too. Hit-Russell fails are latent npc_ko declarations (he is invulnerable). Pass: $15 + preppies respect set 0 via the campaign on_pass (VERIFIED absolute-0 in the recon). Wording is original; ped_model_id records the original model ids next to the stand-in meshes.
